title: Briefing for 2026-11-04
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-04: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report. Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation. Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts. European Central Bank keeps key interest rate on hold at 2.5%. Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates. The politics of President Lagarde's European Central Bank early exit — and who could replace her.
global: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash. Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack. NTSB says crucial plane parts found three miles from Florida crash site. Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes. Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries. Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital.
philippines: San Mateo farmers brace for El Niño after floods wiped out their crops. [OPINION] Apple’s laptop deal with PH’s DepEd: Why people need to keep watching. House adds P5B to its own budget. What got bigger?. World No. 17 Alex Eala downs Emerson Jones to start Hong Kong Open bid.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
